routines.semantics: raw.chbder(cp,x2s,x,nderiv) invokes actual CSPICE for a first-kind Chebyshev expansion and all requested derivatives in x. Degree is the full coefficient count minus one, cp[0] is the full constant coefficient, and s=(x-x2s[0])/x2s[1]. Output order is value then ascending derivatives, with nderiv+1 owned entries; the internal workspace has 3*(nderiv+1) doubles. Order0..715827881 preserves signed workspace indices. Nonempty coefficients are required. Finite transforms are passed unchanged without clamping; reliable-use acceptance requires nonzero scale and normalized s within [-1,1]. All numeric inputs are finite; coefficient/transformation arrays are readonly and outputs own storage. Coefficient counts fit signed32, byte multiplication is checked, and WASM retains its256MiB per-buffer allocation cap including workspace.

routines.semantics: raw.rquad(a,b,c) invokes actual CSPICE for both roots of a*x²+b*x+c, returning owned root1/root2 real-imaginary pairs in actual formula order. Negative leading coefficient can reverse the imaginary sign of root1; no sorting occurs. Linear a=0,b!=0 returns the same value in two separate arrays; a=b=0 signals DEGENERATECASE. Pinned coefficient scaling avoids erasing nonzero coefficients, and the smaller real root uses the root product where applicable. No JavaScript quadratic formula or root-overflow repair is used. All numeric inputs are finite; coefficient/transformation arrays are readonly and outputs own storage. Root storage is fixed at two independent two-double arrays.
